summary: Iteration 7 verification complete. 3/3 backend tests pass: GET /api/categories is now public (no auth required), PATCH /api/profile accepts address, GET /api/auth/me returns address. All 7 frontend checks pass: 401 interceptor redirects /find-pros → /auth (no React error overlay), settings-address-input present + persists, contact-show-location-btn visible for BOTH homeowner and pro with correct Google Maps href (target=_blank), inline msg-show-location-* link in conversation works for both roles, /admin still renders 7 tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: The 401 interceptor in /app/frontend/src/api/client.js works as a *fallback* for mid-session expiry, but the spec's expected URL '/auth?next=/find-pros' is NOT what users see on the cold-load logged-out case — ProtectedRoute in App.js redirects via <Navigate to="/auth" state={{from: location}}> first, so the URL becomes plain '/auth' (no ?next= query). Functionally fine (no error overlay, lands on /auth) but if you specifically rely on reading ?next= from the query string in AuthPage, it will be missing for this path. The interceptor only fires if a 401 leaks from an active session.
InboxPage thread testid is 'thread-{id}' (not 'inbox-thread-{id}' as one might guess). Worth aligning if there are external test suites.
